About this Report
Sanlam Kenya PLC’s 2024 Sustainability
Report presents a comprehensive overview
of the company’s commitment to sustainable
development. Under the theme “Enabling You to Live
with Confidence”, this report covers the period from
January 1, 2024, to December 31, 2024. It has been
prepared in accordance with the Global Reporting
Initiative (GRI) and with reference to the International
Sustainability Standards Board’s IFRS S1 and S2. It
further demonstrates Sanlam Kenya PLC’s alignment
with the UN Global Compact (UNGC) principles, the
Nairobi Securities Exchange (NSE) Environmental,
Social, and Governance (ESG) Disclosure Guidelines,
the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), and
the Taskforce for Nature-related Financial Disclosures
(TNFD).
This report highlights Key Performance Indicators
(KPIs) based on the company’s sustainability strategy
and material sustainability matters, reinforcing our
commitment to responsible business practices.
Sanlam Kenya PLC has adopted a forward-looking,
prudent, and responsible approach to business.
As part of the Sanlam Group, which has been in
existence for 106 years, we continue to create long-
term value by managing a diverse range of risks along
our insurance value chain. We remain confident that
our sustainable business approach will drive long-
term success and resilience.
The 2024 Sustainability Report has been reviewed
and approved through the established governance
processes of the Sanlam Kenya PLC Board Audit,
Risk, and Actuarial Committee, which provides
oversight on sustainability matters.
